Subject: Starter floor options for Hosted API?

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the demo last week. We loved the latency numbers and the model catalog; BrightByte would like to move from POC to a small production pilot in Q4. Before we commit engineering time, the CFO needs a clear picture of minimum monthly spend / floor options for your hosted API (no dedicated GPUs yet).

Specifically:
- What are the minimum monthly commit tiers you offer for hosted?
- Is there a bridge/trial credit structure for a 3-mo ramp?
- How do overages work if we exceed the commit?
- Any constraints for EU region routing (data residency)?

We’re early-stage revenue and prefer a low-entry path, but want predictability for forecasting. Can you send a simple price + commit options matrix and any standard SOW language we should expect?

Thanks —
Kai Morales

Hi Kai —

Great to hear you're ready to pilot. Quick answers up front, then attaching a compact matrix and a starter SOW draft for your procurement team. High-level options we commonly propose for hosted-only customers:

1) Pilot Lite — $1,000/mo effective floor (30-day rolling)
   - Good for initial product validation (~10k tokens/day typical)
   - One-time onboarding credit: 100% of first month (i.e., first month billed as $0) if signed within 14 days
   - Overages billed at pay-as-you-go unit price (no volume discount)

2) Starter Floor — $5,000/mo committed (min 3 months)
   - Predictable unit price with 10% discount vs PAYG
   - Overage smoothing: overages billed monthly; if average monthly usage over the commit term exceeds floor by >50%, we apply a true-up credit or move to next tier on renewal

3) Growth Protect — $25,000/mo committed (6-12 month agreement)
   - Tiered unit pricing, 15–25% discount bands depending on annualization and prepayment
   - Optional SLA add-on for latency targets

Notes:
- Trial/bridge: we can provide a time-limited trial credit (up to $10k) that applies only to token spend; credits do not change minimum committed billing.
- EU routing: hosted customers can request EU-region serving; data-in-transit and residency are supported for models running in our EU region. For regulated workloads we recommend Redwood Private; hosted EU meets common residency needs but check specific audit requirements.
- Standard overage approach: monthly invoiced; if you expect bursty traffic we can add burst protection to absorb short spikes (billed when spikes remain for >7 days).

I’ve attached: short matrix (CSV) and starter SOW PDF. If you want, I can propose a single-page mutual action plan (MAP) mapping milestones to credits/discounts.

Would you be available Wed 23rd at 10:00am PT for a quick call to finalize numbers?

Best,
Ava Chen

Subject: Re: Starter floor options for Hosted API? — suggested concessions

Ava —

Love the quick reply. Two internal points to consider before we lock the MAP:

1) For < $10k ARR pilots, we typically offer a 100% first-month credit OR a one-time $5k onboarding credit (whichever is higher). That preserves a low entry while still having the customer attach value.

2) EU region: if BrightByte requires documented data residency controls beyond region placement (e.g., deletion certification), we should book this as a Professional Services checkbox and price ~ $3k one-time for evidence packaging and SLA paperwork.

Also suggest adding a 60-day automatic conversion clause: if monthly average usage in the pilot months 2–3 exceeds 120% of pilot estimate, we auto-upgrade to Starter Floor (with pro-rated commit) unless customer opts out. That protects capacity planning.

If you want, I can draft the MAP language and margin calc.

-Aditya

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Hi Kai,

Thanks — quick follow-up after internal review and a draft MAP attached. TL;DR options we can sign you to next week: 

Option A — Proof Pilot (lowest-risk)
- Term: month-to-month, effective floor $1,000/mo
- Onboarding credit: first-month spend waived up to $2,500 (applies to token usage only)
- Overage: PAYG unit rate; no long-term commit
- Convert: 30-day notice to convert to Starter Floor with pro-rated credit

Option B — Starter Floor (recommended for predictable spend)
- Term: 3 months minimum, $5,000/mo floor
- Discount: 10% off PAYG unit price applied to committed units
- Overages: billed monthly; if average usage across the 3-mo term is >150% of committed average, we will (a) issue a one-time true-up credit OR (b) offer to upgrade to Growth Protect with a pro-rated commit, whichever you prefer
- Onboarding: $5k onboarding credit applied in month 1 if signed within 7 business days

Option C — Growth Protect (if you know you’ll scale quickly)
- Term: 6–12 months, $25k/mo floor, deeper unit discounts (15–25%) and optional SLA add-on

Administrative notes:
- Billing is monthly, USD. We accept ACH and wire; for EU invoicing we can invoice to BrightByte EMEA entity (requires W-8/W-9 equivalents).
- SOW: attached draft includes scope, pilot acceptance criteria, and standard termination rules.

If you want background on how these options map to cost drivers (batching, quantization, caching), I can loop in Karthik for a short tech call. Otherwise, pick an option and I’ll send a one-page MAP + signature-ready SOW.

Best,
Ava
